scientific_integrity: The theorem has a complete elementary proof and reproducible finite cross-checks; no independent review or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite acyclic directed multiquivers and finite fields; does not cover cycles or infinite quivers.

title: Acyclic-quiver height determines the finite-field free-algebra potential
